title: Deeper/broader comparator route, capability-matrix, and throughput screen
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Compare current open-source DWG/DXF project capability statements by operation and version
Identify bounded optional tools for raw, owner-bound, and large-file DXF comparison
Refine comparator routing without increasing per-slice validation cost

method.kind: Read current project READMEs, documentation, capability tables, and local plan inventory
method.limitations: Project README/version matrices and mutable branch documentation are capability-discovery evidence only. No peer artifact was pinned or executed, and no runtime semantic conclusion is claimed. The optional ezdxf utilities have deliberately narrower scope than a full document/graph or native-consumer check.

sources.observed: The project documents DWG↔DXF converter coverage estimates and a version-limited DXF-to-DWG route; its manual describes DWG writer version caveats. Its prepared-feature comparison, ODA conversion tests, and dwgrewrite self-reread are distinct evidence paths.

sources.revision: Mutable README and four-column DXF/DWG read/write matrix reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The README claims separate DXF and DWG reader/writer support by AC code; AC1012 is DXF-only, AC1021 is listed read-only for DWG, and AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 are listed for both directions. This is not tied to a tested immutable release in this research pass.

The project documents ASCII/Binary DXF version support, an optional iterdxf modelspace iterator for files larger than memory, and a minimal R12 direct writer with a restricted document scope. Its loader separates raw tag/entity creation from later section and owner/layout binding; its information and audit/recovery commands do not represent the same raw/strict route.

sources.project: LibreCAD_3 and LibreCAD bundled libdxfrw inventory
sources.observed: LibreCAD_3 documents optional read-only DWG import and no DWG writing. The bundled-fork inventory calls itself a deterministic source inventory rather than byte-level conformance and marks route evidence as fixture-needed.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing composed comparator checkpoint: choose a peer by exact operation/version; distinguish raw DXF tags, owner-bound graph, and consumer semantics; optionally use streaming tools only for their documented narrow scope. No new required step, dependency, or per-slice validation was added.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin repository and immutable artifact/revision before consuming any peer result; record operation, direction, format version, entity/carrier, options/backend/platform, expected manifest, per-identity disposition, diagnostics, and recovery state.
Use LibreDWG only for an overlapping exact route and do not interpret its aggregate percentages or same-implementation reread as libdxfrw qualification.
Use ACadSharp's version matrix for discovery only; confirm the exact installed release and tested route before drawing a compatibility conclusion.
Use ezdxf raw browsing/ordinary reads for DXF structural comparison; keep recovery/audit separate and compare owner-bound document behavior separately from raw tags.
At the existing composed checkpoint only, optionally use iterdxf for a large modelspace census or its R12 writer for an ENTITIES-only case; neither proves full document graph closure.
Do not add peer dependencies, external drawing fixtures, new CI jobs, or peer/native runs to ordinary implementation slices.
Keep LibreCAD_3 2D consumer compatibility separate from DWG writing, 3D projection, and ACIS semantic claims; retain all six external J items as deferred and non-promoting.
